claim_ceiling: At most a checksum-preserving reacquisition of historically exposed NGA delivery objects; no holdout, feature, painter, reproduction, transfer, or external-confirmation claim.

findings.finding: All eight proposed rows had identical historical asset URLs, local pixels, and feature outcomes in Pilots 0 and 1; normalized identity matching was incomplete.
The collector did not enforce every artifact and runtime hash bound by the freeze.
Successful transport had no defined admission transition, and the acquisition manifest omitted protocol-required provenance fields.
Failure categories, prior-ledger validation, review-decision validation, proxy isolation, and content-encoding handling were insufficiently exact.

review_scope: Independent skeptical review of checklist items 01-19, historical exposure, bound hashes, collection logic, and collector behavior.
